You'll collect a bunch of items to upgrade your weapons and other equipment in Phantom Blade Zero , but how the heck do you upgrade your gear in the first place?
To get right to the answer, you can't upgrade Soul's weapons until you're about an hour into the main story , specifically during the major quest in Weeping Creek Valley: Against the Flow . You'll eventually reach a checkpoint Bell (save point) named ' Outpost ,' where you will meet a blacksmith named Forge . (You can check out our full mission list for Phantom Blade Zero right here )
Once you meet Forge at the Outpost, she'll teach you how to upgrade your weapons . To do so, you'll need a certain amount of forging metal and solvent for each weapon type , plus Remnant Dust. You can get more Remnant Dust by exploring the environment and defeating enemies.
Upgrading your weapons will not only increase the damage they deal and Status Effect effectiveness, but at certain level-up numbers, like level 5 for instance, your weapons can gain new skills and enhancements. For example, the Jagged Steel sword learns Blood Blade at level 5 and then Relentless Bleed at level 10.
After speaking to Forge, you can upgrade your gear at any Bell you come across. You should also be able to sell upgrade materials after speaking to the Peddler at the same encampment.
